posts.title: As beautiful as Nan Tathren, the willow vale is, there’s something unsettling about it too.
posts.description: As beautiful as Nan Tathren, the willow vale is, there’s something unsettling about it too. Voronwë speaks of days and nights going by as he stood in the tall, sweet smelling grass in a trance of sorts. The unceasing rustling of the leaves a music that soothed and entwined.
